The modules are one-liners. Waiting on the three workers' reports to confirm their independent reads.
All three workers finished. The third worker's report did not surface as a message, so I checked `src/c.ts` directly myself to confirm its row.

| Module | Responsibility (one sentence, from its own worker) |
| --- | --- |
| `src/a.ts` | Exports a single constant `a` with the value `1` and nothing else. |
| `src/b.ts` | Exports the constant `b` set to 2, with no other logic or responsibility. |
| `src/c.ts` | Exports the constant `c` set to 3, with no other logic. (Read directly by me; the c worker's own message did not reach the thread.) |

The files are one-liners each (`export const a = 1`, `b = 2`, `c = 3`), so the table above is complete. No files were modified.
The c worker's own report just arrived, so the last row now comes from its worker too. No direct read is needed.

| Module | Responsibility (one sentence, from its own worker) |
| --- | --- |
| `src/a.ts` | Exports a single constant `a` with the value `1` and nothing else. |
| `src/b.ts` | Exports the constant `b` set to 2, with no other logic or responsibility. |
| `src/c.ts` | Exports a single constant `c` with the value 3 and nothing else, so the module holds one immutable numeric value for other modules to import. |

Each of the three workers read only its own module, and no files were modified.
